hypotheses.title: Customer Return Signal Spillover Momentum (pv13 x pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Information propagates gradually along the inter-firm supply chain network. Major customer firms experience fundamental shocks first; supplier firms lag by several days due to market frictions. Ingesting customer return signals (pv13_custretsig_retsig) with a 5-day linear decay captures this lead-lag information transmission. Zero correlation with the 47 existing alphas (0 supply chain alphas exist on this account).
confounders: Customer diversification mitigating supplier revenue impact
Sudden supply chain re-routing during macro trade disputes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during broad sector rotations where customer and supplier decouple completely.

hypotheses.title: Institutional News Tone Continuation Drift (nws12 x pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures post-news drift and gradual institutional reaction to after-hours corporate news articles via vec_avg(nws12_afterhsz_sl). Applying a 5-day linear decay smooths intraday news noise and generates stable subindustry-neutral continuation. Completely decorrelated from fundamental accounting statements and options volatility surfaces.
confounders: Sensationalist retail headlines triggering temporary overreaction
Sparse news days for micro-cap components
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during false rumor spikes that immediately mean-revert upon corporate denial.

hypotheses.title: 30-Day Variance Risk Premium (VRP) Harvest (option8 x pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures the classic Variance Risk Premium (VRP): institutional demand for downside portfolio put insurance permanently bids implied volatility (implied_volatility_mean_30) above subsequent realized volatility (historical_volatility_30). Ranking the spread historical_volatility_30 - implied_volatility_mean_30 harvests this structural risk premium without relying on call/Parkinson ratios, ensuring low correlation against existing approved volatility alphas.
confounders: Sudden realized volatility explosion exceeding implied pricing
Options illiquidity skewing implied volatility quotes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during severe market-wide black swan crashes where realized volatility wildly exceeds implied vol.
